section: Iterate — change: autonomous external review, loud not silent
title: An external review closed unavailable must show the adapter's captured error and is announced
context: An autonomous run whose external review could not run closed the pass not_run and carried on: reason_code unavailable was an unverified claim, and nothing told the operator afterwards. Operator decision: the run may continue, never silently, no env-var waiver.
decision: plan/external_code closed unavailable need the adapter's capture (failure envelope, or stderr when no JSON), read from the commit; record_review_pass refuses it at write time. review_unavailable_note.py prints the PR/F12 line and files one re-run card. The medium+ floor accepts unavailable plus a delegated code row.
consequences: Every iterate-side external_review call also redirects stderr. A successful reply can no longer be closed unavailable. Campaign units can finish at medium+ when the external review fails; 3f-bis still supplies the code review. Limits (unproven delegation, card existence not verified) are in spec_ref.
rationale: The canonical basenames already pin where the adapter writes, so no schema field or CLI flag is needed (WebUI reads the schema); the gate stays inside the existing review-record check, iterate_checks.py untouched.
rejected: Schema field + CLI flag for the artifact path; halting the unit (contradicts the operator decision); an env-var waiver (excluded). Architecture review: GLM and GPT approve.
